048        /**
049         * Financial data node for a monthly income/expenses report.
050         *
051         * <ul>
052         *     <li>Represent a node in the monthly report panel.</li>
053         *     <li>Example: com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.tutorial.GalatianAcademyStipend</li>
054         *     <li>Example: com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.CoreScript.reportEconomyTick(int)</li>
055         * </ul>
056         *
057         * <p>Adding custom node to monthly report under storage section</p>
058         * <pre>
059         * <code>
060         *       MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
061         *         MonthlyReport.FDNode storageNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.STORAGE);
062         *         //Check if the storageNode has been initialized in order to not override the node.
063         *         if(storageNode.name == null) {
064         *             storageNode.name = "Storage";
065         *             storageNode.custom = MonthlyReport.STORAGE;
066         *             storageNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
067         *         }
068         *         //Add in the custom node by getting the storageNode and create a new node from it
069         *         MonthlyReport.FDNode anotherNode = report.getNode(storageNode, "A unique ID");
070         *         anotherNode.name = "Another node inside storage node";
071         * </code>
072         * </pre>
073         * @author Alex Mosolov
074         *
075         * Copyright 2017 Fractal Softworks, LLC
076         *
077         */
078        public static class FDNode {
079                protected LinkedHashMap<String, FDNode> children;
080                public FDNode parent;
081                //public String sortString;
082                public String name;
083                public String icon;
084                
085                public float income;
086                public float upkeep;
087                public float totalIncome;
088                public float totalUpkeep;
089                
090                public Object custom;
091                public Object custom2;
092                public SectorEntityToken mapEntity;
093                
094                public TooltipCreator tooltipCreator = null;
095                public Object tooltipParam;
096
097                public LinkedHashMap<String, FDNode> getChildren() {
098                        if (children == null) return new LinkedHashMap<String, FDNode>();
099                        return children;
100                }
101                
102                public int getDepth() {
103                        FDNode curr = this;
104                        int count = 0;
105                        while (curr.parent != null) {
106                                curr = curr.parent;
107                                count++;
108                        }
109                        return count;
110                }
111        }
112        
113        private FDNode root = new FDNode();
114        private long timestamp;
115        private int debt = 0;
116        private int previousDebt = 0;
117        
118        private MonthlyReportNodeTooltipCreator monthlyReportTooltip;
119        public MonthlyReportNodeTooltipCreator getMonthlyReportTooltip() {
120                if (monthlyReportTooltip == null) {
121                        monthlyReportTooltip = new MonthlyReportNodeTooltipCreator();
122                }
123                return monthlyReportTooltip;
124        }
125        
126        public void computeTotals() {
127                computeTotals(root);
128        }

151                this.debt = debt;
152        }
153
154        public FDNode getRoot() {
155                return root;
156        }
157
158        protected void computeTotals(FDNode curr) {
159                curr.totalIncome = curr.income;
160                curr.totalUpkeep = curr.upkeep;
161                
162                for (FDNode child : curr.getChildren().values()) {
163                        computeTotals(child);
164                }
165                
166                if (curr.parent != null) {
167                        curr.parent.totalIncome += curr.totalIncome;
168                        curr.parent.totalUpkeep += curr.totalUpkeep;
169                }
170        }
171        
172        public List<FDNode> getAllNodes() {
173                List<FDNode> all = new ArrayList<FDNode>();
174                getAllNodes(root, all);
175                return all;
176        }
177        
178        protected void getAllNodes(FDNode curr, List<FDNode> nodes) {
179                nodes.add(curr);
180                
181                for (FDNode child : curr.getChildren().values()) {
182                        getAllNodes(child, nodes);
183                }
184        }
185        
186        public FDNode getNode(String ... path) {
187                return getNode(root, new LinkedList<String>(Arrays.asList(path)));
188        }
189        
190        public FDNode getNode(FDNode from, String ... path) {
191                return getNode(from, new LinkedList<String>(Arrays.asList(path)));
192        }
193        public FDNode getNode(FDNode from, List<String> path) {
194                if (path.isEmpty()) return from;
195                
196                String nextId = path.remove(0);
197                FDNode next = from.children == null ? null : from.children.get(nextId);
198                if (next == null) { 
199                        if (from.children == null) {
200                                from.children = new LinkedHashMap<String, FDNode>();
201                        }
202                        next = new FDNode();
203                        next.parent = from;
204                        from.children.put(nextId, next);
205                }
206                return getNode(next, path);
207        }
208
209        
210        public FDNode getColoniesNode() {
211                FDNode marketsNode = getNode(MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS);
212                if (marketsNode.name == null) {
213                        marketsNode.name = "Colonies";
214                        marketsNode.custom = MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS;
215                        marketsNode.tooltipCreator = getMonthlyReportTooltip();
216                }
217                return marketsNode;
218        }
219        
220        public FDNode getMarketNode(MarketAPI market) {
221                FDNode marketsNode = getColoniesNode();
222                
223                FDNode mNode = getNode(marketsNode, market.getId());
224                if (mNode.name == null) {
225                        mNode.name = market.getName() + " (" + market.getSize() + ")";
226                        mNode.custom = market;
227                }
228                return mNode;
229        }
230        
231        public FDNode getCounterShortageNode(MarketAPI market) {
232                FDNode mNode = getMarketNode(market);
233                
234                FDNode sNode = getNode(mNode, MonthlyReport.STOCKPILING);
235                if (sNode.name == null) {
236                        sNode.name = "Stockpiles used to counter shortages";
237                        sNode.custom = MonthlyReport.STOCKPILING;
238                        sNode.custom2 = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
239                        ((CargoAPI)sNode.custom2).initMothballedShips(Factions.PLAYER);
240                        sNode.tooltipCreator = getMonthlyReportTooltip();
241                }
242                return sNode;
243        }
244        
245        public FDNode getRestockingNode(MarketAPI market) {
246                //FDNode mNode = getMarketNode(market);
247                
248                FDNode mNode = getColoniesNode();
249                
250                FDNode sNode = getNode(mNode, MonthlyReport.RESTOCKING);
251                if (sNode.name == null) {
252                        sNode.name = "Stockpiles drawn by your fleet";
253                        sNode.custom = MonthlyReport.RESTOCKING;
254                        sNode.custom2 = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
255                        ((CargoAPI)sNode.custom2).initMothballedShips(Factions.PLAYER);
256                        sNode.tooltipCreator = getMonthlyReportTooltip();
257                }
258                return sNode;
259        }

261        public FDNode getDebtNode() {
262                FDNode debtNode = getNode(MonthlyReport.LAST_MONTH_DEBT);
263                if (debtNode.name == null) {
264                        debtNode.name = "Last month's debt";
265                        debtNode.custom = MonthlyReport.LAST_MONTH_DEBT;
266                        debtNode.icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("income_report", "generic_expense");
267                        debtNode.tooltipCreator = getMonthlyReportTooltip();
268                }
269                return debtNode;
270        }
